req: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 3.5.1 (PAN rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored, logs included)
msg: A card number (PAN) variable reaches a log, print or exception message.
fix: log card_number[-4:] or the processor token, never the full PAN

req: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 3.3.1.2 (card verification code not retained after authorization)
msg: The card verification code (CVV/CVC) reaches a log, print or exception message.
fix: drop the field before any logger or error handler sees it; log nothing about it

req: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 3.3.1.1 (full track data not retained after authorization)
msg: Magnetic-stripe track data reaches a log, print or exception message.
fix: pass track data straight to the processor and never write it anywhere

req: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 3.3.1.3 (PIN and PIN block not retained after authorization)
msg: A PIN or PIN block reaches a log, print or exception message.
fix: remove the PIN from the message; log only that PIN entry happened

req: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 8.3.2 (authentication factors unreadable during transmission and storage)
msg: A password value reaches a log, print or exception message.
fix: log the user id and the outcome only, never the password

req: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 8.3.2 (authentication factors unreadable during transmission and storage)
msg: Request headers, an API key or a bearer token reach a log, print or exception message.
fix: log a header allow-list (e.g. content-type, request id) instead of request.headers

req: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 3.3.1 (sensitive authentication data not retained after authorization)
msg: A whole request body is logged; on a payment route it carries PAN and CVV.
fix: log named, non-sensitive fields (order id, amount, currency) instead of the body

req: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 3.3.1 (sensitive authentication data not retained after authorization)
msg: locals(), vars() or __dict__ is logged, which writes every variable in scope, card fields included.
fix: log the two or three fields you need by name

req: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 3.5.1 (PAN rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored, logs included)
msg: A 13-19 digit number that passes the Luhn check sits inside a log, print or exception message.
fix: replace it with the last four digits; keep test card numbers out of log text

req: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 3.3.1 and 3.5.1 (card data sent to a third-party error tracker is stored there)
msg: Sentry is initialised with send_default_pii=True, which attaches headers, cookies and user data to every event.
fix: set send_default_pii=False and scrub card fields in before_send
